parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The fuzzy match field for the server. The value can be a server name or IP address.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The protection status of the servers that you want to query. Valid values:
- **on**: Protection is enabled.
- **off**: Protection is disabled.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the asset that you want to query.
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
